theme_strategy: Strict Dark Mode to inherently communicate stealth, zero-knowledge, and secure local environment.

typography.headings: Azeret Mono (font-mono). Avoid regular weights, use font-light or font-black.
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans (font-sans). Clean, highly legible UI font.
typography.rules: H1 max text-5xl tracking-tighter. Overlines MUST be Uppercase + tracking-[0.2em].

visual enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. border-collapse layouts with 1px border-border/40 lines.
visual enhancers.corners: Hard edges. rounded-none on all components to enforce Brutalist function-first design.
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (bg-black/50 + svg noise filter) on the unlock screen to prevent digital flatness.
visual enhancers.empty_states: ASCII Art for locks or empty folders. E.g., [x] EMPTY VAULT. Keeps the developer/terminal aesthetic.

grids.dashboard: MODE B (High Density Grid). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gap-4. Every pixel utilized. border-collapse styling.
grids.document_grid: Grid items must have 1px solid border. Hover states lift slightly and border shifts to cyan.

layouts.app_shell: Left Sidebar (w-64) + Main Content. h-screen overflow-hidden. Inner scrolling for main content.
layouts.header: Solid #0A0A0A background (NO transparency). Bottom border to cleanly cut off scrolling content.
layouts.unlock_screen: Flex center, minimal UI, focused on the central passphrase input. No generic login card. Just a stark terminal input.
layouts.padding: Generous Spacing Philosophy. p-8 inside structural blocks.

motion.hover_states: Crisp and sudden. transition: transform 0.1s ease, border-color 0.1s ease. No 'transition-all'.
motion.unlock_sequence: Fast 'decryption' glitch effect (staggered opacity or character scrambling) on successful passphrase before routing.
motion.upload_drag: Border dashes scale up slightly and pulse cyan when a file is hovered over the drop zone.

accessibility.contrast: APCA validated. White on Void Black exceeds Lc 90. Cyan on Void Black exceeds Lc 75.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='unlock-button').

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react). Use weight='duotone' for documents/folders to add technical depth.
media.images_strategy: No standard photography needed for a secure vault. Pure UI, typography, and iconography.

3d libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific local utility, prioritizing speed and zero-knowledge footprint. Use CSS for 'decryption' text effects instead.

texture.description: Use CSS-based SVG noise filters rather than external images to keep the app 100% local.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react sonner
Ensure all components use .jsx / .js extensions, not .tsx.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for the header/search bar area if items scroll behind it; use solid #0A0A0A or #050505.
Build a Brutalist layout: remove all border-radius (rounded-none). Add explicit 1px borders (border-[#27272A]) to structure the sidebar, header, and grid items.
For the Unlock Screen, create a minimalist input field (border-b only) in the center of the screen, styled like a terminal prompt.
For the Document Grid, format items like file packets. Show metadata (size, type, date) explicitly in monospace font.
Ensure the Upload Drag & Drop zone uses a massive dashed border (border-dashed border-[#27272A]) that turns cyan on drag over.
Use ASCII art or purely typographic lock symbols for empty states.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, and file items for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
